content.short: CHATEAU issues chUSD, a synthetic dollar that earns yield from Wall Street private credit.
content.description: CHATEAU issues chUSD, an overcollateralized synthetic dollar. Staking it gives schUSD, an ERC-4626 vault with exposure to Wall Street private credit strategies, which can then be used across DeFi. DefiLlama tracks CHATEAU on Plasma and Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists it.
content.meta: CHATEAU issues chUSD, a synthetic dollar earning private-credit yield via schUSD, live on Plasma.
